# Commit messages
- Always write clear and concise commit messages that describe the changes made in the commit. Use the present tense and avoid using vague language.
- Start the commit message with one of (feat: | fix: | docs: | style: | refactor: | test: | chore: ) to indicate the type of change being made. followed with a brief description of the change.
- For larger commits, include at max 5 bullet points it easier for others to review and understand the changes.
